executiveSummary: Overall OT/ICS cyber threat level: HIGH Perimeter device exploitation risk remains acute. Unauthenticated RCE and DoS in Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway are actively exploited, with multiple government CERTs publishing IOCs and emergency guidance. Organizations should patch immediately, invalidate sessions, and hunt for persistence. Security Advisory CISA KEV F5 BIG-IP APM OAuth stack is under in-the-wild exploitation (CVE-2026-94127), enabling unauthenticated RCE on commonly deployed access gateways. Prioritize vendor hotfixes or the interim iRule and restrict APM OAuth endpoints. Security Advisory Real-world OT impacts observed: attackers remotely triggered forced defrost cycles on Danfoss industrial refrigeration controllers across European supermarkets, causing physical spoilage. Immediately remove controllers from the public internet, update/replace obsolete units, and enforce authenticated remote access. View Article Multiple ICS/OT gateway and protocol stack flaws surfaced in CISA weekly bulletins, including unauthenticated remote control and command injection on Advantech EKI-1242EIMS and critical issues in Advantech WISE-6610 LoRaWAN gateways. Segment, block mgmt ports, and schedule urgent firmware updates. CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin ShinyHunters mass-exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) impacted government and transportation; WAF-evasion via URL encoding observed. Patch immediately and hunt for data theft and cloud pivots. View Article Strategic risk: U.S. and allied agencies warn of China-linked campaigns blending automated and hands-on tradecraft against critical infrastructure operators; proactive hunting and segmentation remain essential. Ransomware operators weaponize Active Directory via domain-root GPO hijacking to disable firewalls, push notes, and prepare disruption, with potential OT workstation impact where trusts exist. Kaspersky Report

relevance: Edge attacks (Citrix, F5) and enterprise app exploitation (PeopleSoft) create credible ingress to environments supporting critical operations. CISA assessments show practical IT-to-OT pivots through AD, cloud identity, and mis-segmented jump paths, while real-world OT manipulation of Danfoss controllers demonstrates consequences of Internet exposure and legacy controller insecurity. High exposure: Remote access gateways, SSL VPNs, ADCs, APMs Critical OT assets surfaced in bulletins: Industrial protocol gateways, LoRaWAN gateways, DDS/RTPS middleware Observed impacts: Physical spoilage (refrigeration), potential operator access disruption, data theft enabling targeted OT phishing

descriptions: Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190): Citrix NetScaler, F5 BIG-IP APM, PeopleSoft web tiers
Valid Accounts (T1078) and Abuse of Single Sign-On/OAuth tokens
Phishing (T1566) and Social Engineering for remote tools (Luna Moth)
Web Shell (T1505.003) on edge appliances; config tampering/persistence
Credential Access and ADCS abuse (e.g., ESC1), DCSync (T1003, T1550)
Lateral Movement via Remote Services (T1021), VPN abuse, and cloud pivots
Command and Control over Web Protocols (T1071), proxy infrastructures

outlook72h: Expect sustained probing and exploitation attempts against Citrix NetScaler and F5 BIG-IP APM; prioritize emergency patch windows and compromise assessments. Likely follow-on opportunistic attacks against Internet-exposed ICS gateways and refrigeration/industrial controllers; conduct external exposure sweeps and implement ACLs/VPNs. Continued PeopleSoft targeting with encoding-based WAF evasion; monitor HR/SSO logs for anomalous sessions and large exports; rotate credentials/tokens. Elevated risk of IT-to-OT pivot in organizations with weak segmentation; validate jump host controls, block OT egress, and tighten identity paths.
